objections.reason: 'bondad acumulada' is already the children's rendering of puṇya (T007); saṃbhāra needs a distinct term (provisions).
Same epithet as T070; inconsistent wording and capitalisation ('el Que Así se Fue' vs 'el que se fue así').
English is 'Well-Gone One'; 'llegó a la felicidad' departs from it and breaks parallel with 'el que se fue así' (Tathāgata).
'Mányushri' is a non-standard respelling and inconsistent with T206 'Mañjushri'; ñ renders the Sanskrit sound correctly in Spanish.
English is 'freedom from sorrow'; T152 uses 'liberación de la tristeza'. 'Sufrimiento' is the rendering of duḥkha (T001); keep distinct.
Same Sanskrit bāla as T176, where children gets 'persona necia'; 'persona infantil' is ambiguous and inconsistent.
'maestro' is also used for ācārya (T202); guru needs a distinct academic rendering.
T293 (same word tshogs pa, 'collection') uses 'conjunto', the better Spanish word; 'colección' suggests a set of objects, not parts of a whole.
